reviewNotes: Sandy's complete six-line birthday schedule dialogue asset is translated directly from English, preserving her warm friendship with Emily and every dialogue control exact.

Sandy_Birthday_Greeting.source: Oh, Emily! I was hoping you'd show up!$h#$b#I was actually feeling a little lonely this morning.#$e#But I'm glad you're here!$h
Sandy_Birthday_Greeting.translation: O, Emily! Speram să apari!$h#$b#De fapt, m-am simțit puțin singură în dimineața asta.#$e#Dar mă bucur că ești aici!$h

Sandy_Birthday_Hangout.source: How's that Stardew Valley weather right now?#$e#The flowers there smell lovely.$h
Sandy_Birthday_Hangout.translation: Cum este vremea în Stardew Valley acum?#$e#Florile de acolo miros minunat.$h

Sandy_Birthday_Lake.source: It always seems to stay a little cooler by the lake.#$e#It's good to get out of the house now and then!$h
Sandy_Birthday_Lake.translation: Lângă lac pare să fie mereu puțin mai răcoare.#$e#Este bine să mai ieși din casă din când în când!$h

Sandy_Birthday_Camel.source: I think she sells some rare products.
Sandy_Birthday_Camel.translation: Cred că vinde niște produse rare.

Sandy_Birthday_Bye.source: I had a great time.$h#$b#Thanks for being my friend.$h#$e#Come back again any time!$h
Sandy_Birthday_Bye.translation: M-am simțit grozav.$h#$b#Mulțumesc că-mi ești prietenă.$h#$e#Întoarce-te oricând!$h
